verdict.rationale: Gide Loyrette Nouel is a law firm offering advisory and litigation services, not a software product or platform. Asking whether it offers an official MCP server for agents is a category error for this kind of provider. The evidence only shows the firm uses AI internally and advises clients on AI; it shows no MCP server or other agent-facing interface, and the llms.txt and OpenAPI probes returned 404, so nothing flips the axis to applicable.
